C1246.title: Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Out Scam Disguised as Loan Qualification Improvement
C1246.summary: In June 2024, the Yangzhou Intermediate People's Court disclosed a fraud case. A criminal gang, under the pretense of helping victims obtain online loans, fabricated poor credit status to trick victims into cashing out their Alipay Huabei or JD Baitiao credit limits and charged exorbitant fees.
